title: Update CSS and SCSS files
description: This updates the `styles.scss` file, which is compiled to `styles.css` via the node `sass-watch` package. The additions here are for making the data UI appear more like the Tableau web interface.

title: Greatly reduce boilerplate for config UI
description:
- Common config dialog elements now provided automatically
- Validation support added via `iv` argument to config_server
- Initial loading indicator added to both embed and config views
- update_tableau_settings now returns a promise that can be waited
  on; and therefore is now named update_tableau_settings_async.
  This was necessary because Tableau errors if you attempt to have
  two or more settings update operations concurrently.

title: Add functionality around a YAML manifest file
description:
Several new functions facilitate the use of a YAML manifest file. The `yaml_skeleton()` function creates a skeleton YAML file with all fields and dummy values. The `tableau_manifest_from_yaml()` reads in a YAML manifest field and feeds the values to `tableau_manifest()`.

I'd like to modify `tableau_manifest()` somewhat, if only to make it somewhat nicer for the developer when going directly from `yaml_skeleton()` to a functioning prototype (i.e., not filling in the manifest details until later stages of development).

title: Create `corrr` app
description: This is a Tableau extension that shows a correlation plot based on a single data table (numeric columns are automatically selected from a specified table).
